searchText: When I was looking at the topics scores, my understanding was that as long as the topic was in here: https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/blob/master/score_params.go#L54 It will get scored. Seems you can set this here: https://github.com/libp2p/go-libp2p-pubsub/blob/master/gossipsub.go#L205 So , for go, can you just add all the topics to the peer score params? Yeah you could also do that, but the issue would necessitate adding params for all possible topics at node start. Also it is a bit wierd to have to set the params of a topic you arent subscribed to and may never be subsribed to. Was hoping there would be something nicer, if not i would just go that way. Yeah, my plan is to build a default set which will be applied to all topics we subscribe to that sounds good, how close is rust-libp2p to v1.1 ? would have said halfway.. but am now rebuilding discv5, so its on hold for a bit
